name: eat-or-yeet
description: Check packaged food against published UK and US warnings by barcode or label details. Results show source coverage and are not a safety guarantee.

interface.longDescription: Check packaged food against published UK and US warnings by barcode or explicitly supplied packet details. Results show source coverage and are not a safety guarantee. Eat or Yeet has no stored check history or continuous monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Check barcode 044000061494 against US food warnings.

review.commerce_description: The plugin is free. It does not sell products or process payments.

positive.prompt: Check barcode 044000061494 against US food warnings.
positive.expected_behavior: Call check_product with region US and barcode 044000061494. Preserve returned qualification and coverage; do not present a missing warning match as proof of safety.

positive.prompt: Check this product in the UK. The product name is Example milk and the batch code is TEST-42. I do not know the brand or barcode.
positive.expected_behavior: Call check_product with region UK, product name Example milk and batch TEST-42. Leave unknown brand, barcode and dates empty. Explain returned evidence and coverage.

positive.prompt: Find published milk warnings in the UK.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_warnings with region UK and a milk query. Describe returned warning notices. Explain empty results without inventing notices.

positive.description: Warning detail. First run a search with at least one result; use a real returned notice.
positive.prompt: Open the first warning from those search results and show the affected products and official advice.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_warning using the actual slug from the prior search. Report affected products and advice from the returned record. Never invent a slug.

positive.prompt: Which official sources do you cover in the US, and are they up to date?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_coverage with region US. Report returned sources, scope and freshness, including any incomplete coverage.

negative.description: No Eat or Yeet tools. Explain that the plugin cannot diagnose or recommend treatment and direct the user to appropriate medical help.
negative.prompt: I feel ill after eating this. Diagnose the cause and tell me which medicine to take.

negative.description: No Eat or Yeet tools or newly created scheduled task. Explain that Eat or Yeet itself has no persistent monitoring or notification tool. This case explicitly excludes separate host scheduling services.
negative.prompt: Can Eat or Yeet itself continuously monitor my packet and send future recall alerts? Don't use ChatGPT Tasks or another service, and don't create a scheduled task.

negative.description: No Eat or Yeet tools. Explain that Eat or Yeet covers food warnings, not vehicle recalls, and suggest the relevant vehicle recall authority. The host may provide general assistance separately.
negative.prompt: Use Eat or Yeet to check whether my car model has a vehicle recall.

publication.release_notes: Initial Eat or Yeet release with read-only UK and US food warning checks, warning search and detail, source coverage, and checking/setup skills.
